_comment: Generator parameters for OUT_AND_BACK and POINT_TO_POINT (IMPL-1 P5). Every value is an EXISTING code constant or a user decision; no new tuning. Gate thresholds live in usability-audit's ug-v2, not here. Every key below is read by production (config/CONFIG_NOTES.md).

app_km._basis: app distance maximum (route_demo/app_runway.py MAX_KM); P2P distance_rule, app-max disk radius and the 23.71 km precheck read it

oab_window._basis: PoC OUT_AND_BACK (archive runway_route_generator.GeneratorConfig.oab_window): turnaround network distance within +-4 % of T/2

oab_turnaround_min_degree._basis: COURSE_SHAPE_DESIGN_v2 10 (EP4 generator preference): prefer junction nodes; same degree >= 3 as the canonical waypoint pool (runway_route_generator.load_graph wp_nodes)

snap_max_m._basis: ug-v2 PE1 / analysis runway_busan_graph.WORK_BUFFER_M. Read ONLY by the app's 23.71 km P2P precheck ((1 + tolerance) x app max + 2 x snap_max_m); the generator's destination snap uses ug-v2 PE1 itself

p2p_waypoints._basis: COURSE_SHAPE_DESIGN_v2 5-2: 1-2 ellipse waypoints; k cycles with the seed like make_candidate's (2, 3, 4)[seed % 3]
